summary: Two US military personnel were killed and one remains missing following Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks on a base in Jordan on July 17. The US completed a wave of strikes on Iranian coastal monitoring, air defense, naval capabilities, missile and drone storage sites, and IRGC forces. Iranian drone strikes also targeted US ammunition depot at Camp Al-Udeiri and Patriot radar at Ali Al Salem base in Kuwait.
key_points: CENTCOM stated two US military personnel were killed and one missing in Jordan on July 17 while defending against Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks (Source: @VahidOnline/77247).
The US military completed a wave of attacks on Iran, striking coastal monitoring facilities, air defense, naval capabilities, missile and drone storage, and IRGC forces (Source: @N12chat/218017).
Iran's Army conducted drone strikes on a US ammunition depot at Camp Al-Udeiri and Patriot radar at Ali Al Salem base in Kuwait (Source: @naya_foriraq/84128).
US struck a point near Hajjiabad in Hormozgan province at 2:10 and explosions reported in Bandar Abbas port city (Source: @kianmeli1/89621).
IDF eliminated a PIJ sniper and a Hamas operations directorate member in central and northern Gaza Strip via aerial strikes (Source: @New_security8200/202737).
IDF commando brigade forces with Division 36 identified and struck a Hezbollah drone operators cell near Kfar Tebnit security zone (Source: @idf_telegram/24663).
A Lebanese Army vehicle struck a charge in Al-Mansouri south Lebanon, killing one soldier and wounding two; Hezbollah suspected (Source: @idf_telegram/24665).
Arab countries and international organizations condemned Iranian attacks on Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, Jordan and northern Iraq (Source: @mamlekate/103939).

sections.executive_summary: Two US military personnel were killed and one remains missing following Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks on a base in Jordan on July 17. The US completed a wave of strikes on Iranian coastal monitoring, air defense, naval capabilities, missile and drone storage sites, and IRGC forces. Iranian drone strikes also targeted US ammunition depot at Camp Al-Udeiri and Patriot radar at Ali Al Salem base in Kuwait amid widening regional confrontation.

points: CENTCOM reported that on July 17, two US military personnel were killed in Jordan while defending against Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks, with one still missing and four evacuated to hospitals in Jordan (Source: @VahidOnline/77247).

The US military announced completion of a strike wave on Iran, attacking coastal monitoring facilities, air defense systems, naval capabilities, missile and drone storage sites, and IRGC forces that launched attacks on US forces in Jordan on July 17 (Source: @N12chat/218017).

US struck a point near Hajjiabad in Hormozgan province at 2:10; residents claimed 3-5 projectiles hit Qeshm Island after explosions at 03:38 local; explosions also reported in Bandar Abbas port (Source: @kianmeli1/89621).

Iran's Army stated in its sixteenth 'Lightning' operation it targeted a US ammunition depot at Camp Al-Udeiri and Patriot/aerial radars at Ali Al Salem base in Kuwait with suicide drones (Source: @naya_foriraq/84128).
An M4.9 earthquake occurred 56 km NW of Shushtar, Iran; Khuzestan governor ordered full emergency readiness of relief forces following the quake (Source: @shin_persian/8176).
Governor of Arak denied rumors of explosion in the city, stating conditions are completely normal with no reports of attack or explosion (Source: @rodast_omiddana/76823).
IDF eliminated a Palestinian Islamic Jihad sniper, Ala'a Khamis Aqasha Abu Bariq, in central Gaza Strip who advanced sniping plots against IDF forces (Source: @New_security8200/202737).

IDF also eliminated Muhammad Taysir Ahmad Ubayd, a Hamas operations directorate section head, in northern Gaza Strip; both were struck from the air as immediate threats (Source: @New_security8200/202737).

IDF Commando Brigade forces under Division 36 identified an enemy drone near Kfar Tebnit and with IAF struck a Hezbollah drone operators cell hiding near the security zone (Source: @idf_telegram/24663).

Northern Command and Defense Ministry abandoned protection of 11 military sites on Lebanon border due to budget shortfall; civilian contractor work stopped as payments halted (Source: @naya_foriraq/84135).

A source claimed internal Iranian disputes pose existential threat to Revolutionary Guards; US reportedly does not want Israel to join campaign even if Iran attacks Israel (Source: @inon_yttach/9520).

An Israeli official source claimed Iran planned to assassinate Israeli officials to avenge the killing of Khamenei; a Hezbollah cell attempt on Yair Netanyahu in Miami was thwarted (Source: @pkpoi/143330).
IDF eliminated a PIJ sniper in central Gaza Strip who in recent period advanced sniping patterns against IDF forces operating in the Strip (Source: @New_security8200/202737).

In a separate strike in northern Gaza Strip, IDF eliminated a Hamas operations directorate section head who advanced terror patterns against Israeli citizens and IDF forces (Source: @New_security8200/202737).
Helicopters targeted a point in Al-Shati Camp west of Gaza City a short time ago according to Palestinian sources (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378882).
Israeli occupation forces continued raiding Barqa village northwest of Nablus with manhunt and arrest operations per Palestinian sources (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378889).
Southern Command IDF forces are deployed in the Gaza Strip per agreement and will continue to remove immediate threats per the military spokesperson (Source: @New_security8200/202737).
IDF Commando Brigade forces with Division 36 detected an enemy drone near Kfar Tebnit and directed IAF to strike a Hezbollah drone operators cell near the security zone (Source: @idf_telegram/24663).

A Lebanese Army vehicle hit a charge in Al-Mansouri in south Lebanon security zone, killing one soldier and wounding two; IDF says charge likely placed by Hezbollah, no IDF presence recently (Source: @idf_telegram/24665).

Israeli Northern Command and Defense Ministry decided to abandon protection of 11 military sites on Lebanese border due to lack of budget for contractor protection works (Source: @naya_foriraq/84135).
Red Link Lebanon called on public to report hostile drones via designated bots for community protection (Source: @redlinkleb/31898).
Clashes expanded in Azaz city, Aleppo province, Syria, with large military reinforcements of al-Jolani terrorist gangs arriving in the city (Source: @naya_foriraq/84107).
C-RAM air defense activity was observed earlier in Erbil, Kurdistan Region of Iraq (Source: @shin_persian/8165).
Iran's Leader Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei thanked Iraqi people for epic reception and funeral processions for the late Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5143).
Arab countries and international organizations condemned Iranian attacks on northern Iraq among other targets on Saturday July 27 (Source: @mamlekate/103939).
Iran's Army targeted US ammunition depot at Camp Al-Udeiri, 104 km from Iran border, and Patriot radar at Ali Al Salem air base in Kuwait with suicide drones (Source: @naya_foriraq/84128).
Air raid sirens sounded in Kuwait following an Iranian air attack, per a report (Source: @naya_foriraq/84143).
Arab countries and international organizations condemned Iranian attacks on Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, Jordan and northern Iraq as sovereignty violations (Source: @mamlekate/103939).
Iranian media claimed capability to capture US bases in Iraq, Kuwait and Bahrain amid rumors of US invasion of Iran (Source: @lelotsenzura/93727).

key_developments: Two US military personnel killed and one missing in Jordan on July 17 during Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks on a base; four evacuated to Jordan hospitals (Source: @VahidOnline/77247).
US completed strike wave on Iran hitting coastal monitoring, air defense, naval capabilities, missile and drone storage, and IRGC forces that attacked Jordan base (Source: @N12chat/218017).
Iran's Army drone strikes hit US ammunition depot at Camp Al-Udeiri and Patriot radar at Ali Al Salem base in Kuwait in 16th 'Lightning' operation (Source: @naya_foriraq/84128).
US struck near Hajjiabad, Hormozgan at 2:10; explosions in Bandar Abbas and 3-5 projectiles reported on Qeshm Island after 03:38 local (Source: @kianmeli1/89621).
IDF eliminated PIJ sniper and Hamas operations section head in central and northern Gaza Strip via aerial strikes as immediate threats (Source: @New_security8200/202737).
IDF Division 36 commando and IAF struck Hezbollah drone operators cell near Kfar Tebnit security zone after drone detection (Source: @idf_telegram/24663).
Lebanese Army vehicle hit charge in Al-Mansouri south Lebanon, killing one and wounding two; Hezbollah suspected, no IDF presence in area (Source: @idf_telegram/24665).
sections.threat_assessment: Iranian drone and missile attacks on US forces in Jordan and Kuwait represent direct escalation against US presence, with two US deaths and one missing at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base. The US response striking Iranian air defense, coastal monitoring, and IRGC forces indicates readiness for sustained confrontation. Hezbollah drone operations near the Lebanon security zone and a thwarted assassination plot against an Israeli figure in Miami suggest expanded covert and proxy threats. Internal Iranian instability and budget-driven gaps in Israeli border defenses add operational vulnerability for both sides.
sections.regional_response: Arab countries and international organizations condemned Iranian attacks on Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, Jordan and northern Iraq as sovereignty violations threatening regional stability. Iran's leadership expressed bonds with Iraq via funeral processions for Khamenei, while Iranian media claimed ability to seize US bases in Iraq, Kuwait and Bahrain. US officials and Trump emphasized continued pressure and rejection of Iranian nuclear capability, signaling potential further strikes on Iranian infrastructure per NYT reporting cited in sources.
sections.intelligence_notes: CENTCOM withheld identities of killed personnel for 24 hours pending family notification, limiting immediate attribution detail. Conflicting timestamps appear: one message cites July 17 attack, another cites July 26 (Tir 26) for same Jordan event; analysts should verify exact date. Reports of explosions in Arak were officially denied, while Bandar Abbas and Qeshm incidents lack official Iranian casualty confirmation. Israeli northern border protection gaps at 11 sites due to contractor non-payment merit monitoring for Hezbollah exploitation.
